key_findings: Integrated bioinformatics and machine learning identified MMP9, HPGD and UCHL1 as IDD diagnostic biomarkers; in IL-1β-treated rat NP cells MMP9 rose while UCHL1 and HPGD fell.
Single-cell CellChat analysis showed MIF signaling from chondrocytes to monocytes and T cells (CD74-CD44/CXCR4) in the IDD immune microenvironment.
